coverage.summary: Applies statewide to residential tenants of residential dwelling units in Massachusetts. The statute states no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits.
coverage.other_conditions: Residential tenants of residential dwelling units only.

evidence.quoted_span: A notice to quit for nonpayment of rent given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant pursuant to this chapter shall be accompanied by a form

result.notes: I removed the summary's claim that the Boston HSNA and Cambridge ch. 8.71 local notice ordinances apply in addition, because no document in the set supports it. I reworded other_conditions to describe the covered units and tenants rather than landlord conduct; the notice-to-quit trigger belongs in the rule requirement, not in coverage. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the rule reaches ordinary residential tenancies statewide. D058 contains no exemptions, unit thresholds or construction-date limits.
